'''Rain in High Wind''' is a [[sword form]]. Other than the name, nothing is known about it. During the duel between [[Eamon Valda]] and [[Galadedrid Damodred]], Galad used this form desperately quick as a response to Valda's use of the form [[River of Light]].{{ref/book|11|p}}
